title: They Stomped Him Until He Stopped Moving . . . And Nobody Called For Help (Episode 7)
caption:
Weak Hero Class 1, episode 7: Max walks into a boxing gym to make Bobby apologize to Sam and Amy.
Bobby paid a fighter named Wolf to beat him, and the fight ends with Max on the mat, not breathing. Follow for episode 8!

#weakhero #kdrama #kdramarecap #recap #spoilerroom
comment: Is Bobby too far gone to forgive after this? Why?

segments.say: Max lies flat in a boxing ring, and one of the boys whispers, he isn't *breathing*.
To see how it got here, go back to the night Sam woke up in an *ambulance*.
The police ask who did this to him. Sam just says, I was *alone*.
Amy hears him cover for her. He tells her, never tell Max what happened *today*.
At home, Max sits next to a birthday cake and a phone that never *rings*.
Sam steps outside and calls Bobby. He has one thing to *say*.

segments.text: Stop this. Now. Leave Max alone.

segments.say: Back at Sam's house, his parents turn on each other. Where were you when he got *hurt*?
Sam hides in his room while they scream through the *door*.
In the hospital, his dad asks if it was the same *guys*.
Sam says he fell down the stairs. His dad cuts him off. You're transferring *schools*.
Then Sam finally asks. Since when have you cared about me so *much*?
Fair question, honestly.
Meanwhile Bobby's father, an assemblyman, has his aide fix everything. The police, the principal, a school in the *Philippines*.
Bobby sits alone in his room, waiting to be shipped *out*.
At school, Max sleeps through class, because Sam hasn't answered a single *call*.
Then Sam texts him. Something came up at home, I won't be in for a *while*.
Max doesn't buy it. Finals are tomorrow, but first he goes looking for Bobby's *friends*.
They say Bobby's phone is off. Max says Bobby owes him eight hundred thousand won for the *scooter*.
Up on the roof, Bobby's friends panic. We need to take care of *Max*.
Then Max walks up, and they talk fast. Bobby used Amy as bait, and Sam showed up *instead*.
Bobby paid someone to beat Sam up. We were just *bystanders*.
That's what cowards always say.
Max goes straight to Amy. Where is Sam? Which *hospital*?
She begs him to stay out of it. Sam didn't want you to *know*.
That night, Max rings Sam's door, dressed as a delivery *boy*.
Sam is studying with his arm in a *cast*.
Max only asks for water, and whether Sam will be at finals tomorrow. Sam says, I need to *be*.
Max says nothing about what he knows. He just walks out, and that is when the *anger* starts.
Across town, Bobby's father catches him and loses *it*.
You will study abroad, he says. Just never tell anyone I'm your *son*.
Bobby bolts for the street, jumps in a car, and tells the driver, just *drive*.
His phone fills with missed calls. Then one message. Answer, or I will kill your *friends*.
Max has been *busy*. He grabs Bobby's friends one by one, asking where Bobby is hiding.
Then he calls Bobby himself. Where are you? Stop *hiding*.
Bobby panics and calls Wolf, a fighter who hits for *money*. Let's get Max, I'll pay.
Bobby just made the worst call.
Sam hears Max went dark. He wouldn't go after Bobby, would *he*?
Max walks into a boxing gym where Bobby's whole gang is *waiting*.
Bobby finally shows up. Max stays calm. You should have taken it out on me, not those *kids*.
Max says sorry for upsetting him. Now *apologize* to Sam and Amy. Bobby says no.
So Max says he will beat him until he comes to his *senses*.
But Bobby paid for this. Wolf is the fighter Max beat in middle school, and he wants *revenge*, live on camera.
The fight starts. Max puts Wolf on the *mat*.
But Wolf gets back up, and the fight turns *ugly*.
Then Max goes *down*, and he stays down.
Bobby leans over him. You always looked down on *me*, he says.
Max tells him from the floor. Stop blaming *others*, Bobby.
That's when Bobby snaps. His friends jump in, and the stomping *starts*.
Max never stood a chance.
They keep going until Max stops *answering*.
Someone shakes him. Hey, he isn't *breathing*.
A man in a suit walks in, Bobby's father's aide. Stay here, he says. If you run, it gets *worse*.
Bobby drops next to Max, shaking, and *begs* him to wake up.
The gang drags Bobby away while Max's eyes stay *closed*.
Across town, Sam and Amy search an empty garage for *Max*.
Where is Max? He isn't here. Sam keeps calling, and nobody *answers*.
And back in the empty ring, Max lies completely still. Is he still *alive*?
